description: This bar chart illustrates the average JGA score for two models, LLaMA-7B and T5-small, across a series of turns. The horizontal axis represents “Turn ID”, with labels ranging from 0 to 26 in sequential order, while the vertical axis is labeled "Avg. JGA Score" and represents a linear scale from 0.2 to 1.0 with tick marks at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0.  For each Turn ID, there are two adjacent bars: one orange representing LLaMA-7B and one yellow representing T5-small. The heights of the bars vary for each turn; for example, at Turn ID 0, the LLaMA-7B bar reaches approximately 0.96, while the T5-small bar reaches approximately 0.92.  Conversely, at Turn ID 26, the LLaMA-7B bar extends to around 0.68 and the T5-small bar reaches approximately 0.36.  The bars are arranged in ascending order based on Turn ID. No bars are visibly emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining or annotations.
